name: Dairy-manure-derived PHBV, operational-day sample PHBV-39

names.zh: 奶牛粪便来源 PHBV，运行日样品 PHBV-39
names.ja: 乳牛糞尿由来PHBV、運転日試料PHBV-39

identity_scope: PHBV-39 isolated from mixed microbial consortia fed fermented dairy manure in the study. 39 denotes operational day, not 39% HV, a grade, a specimen count or a distinct polymer family. Other operational days are not additional material identities in this batch.
